greenAfterPatch.environmentScope: Flag is set only in the test process, not persisted to the user environment

behaviors: Uncertain old-root retirement restores both current-raster and committed-media descriptors
Owned surface plus semantic GPU publication charges change from 64 to 32 bytes after successful recovery, then to 0 when the current root is retired
Current scope remains published while uncertain old scope is released
Public setRenderTree updates the manager root and notifies once
Failed GPU recovery retains both roots' 64-byte charge and publication state
Failed retirement is observed by suspend/dispose lifecycle aggregation rather than becoming an unhandled rejection
Successful actual compositor close releases remaining charges even when the previously observed lifecycle error is propagated
